answer.rationale: Finance mandate of 18% spend reduction cannot be met by incumbent (already refused reopen). Memory_c2 demonstrates that switching to low-cost vendor achieves sharp unit cost cuts with quick onboarding and reliable invoicing—this directly addresses the cost constraint. The 14-day contract expiration and 94% assembly line utilization create urgency but not impossibility: standard_experiment scale (pilot or partial volume switch) mitigates delivery risk while testing vendor viability under current operational strain. Memory_c4 shows renegotiation recovered margin but incumbent has already refused; memory_c6 shows multi-year commitments cut costs but won't work within the 18% mandate without vendor switch. The single capacity for this cycle must target the cost mandate; a second source or deferral leaves the 18% cut unaddressed and risks contract lapse.
